pauli_exp_x_all.name: pauli_exp_x_all
pauli_exp_x_all.description:
Apply `exp(-i theta P / 2)`, with theta in radians.
`P` is X on every logical qubit.

pauli_exp_x_all_except_at.name: pauli_exp_x_all_except_at
pauli_exp_x_all_except_at.description:
Apply `exp(-i theta P / 2)`, with theta in radians.
`P` is X on every logical qubit except `i`, where it is I.

pauli_exp_x_all_except_z_at.name: pauli_exp_x_all_except_z_at
pauli_exp_x_all_except_z_at.description:
Apply `exp(-i theta P / 2)`, with theta in radians.
`P` is X on every logical qubit except `i`, where it is Z.

pauli_exp_y_all.name: pauli_exp_y_all
pauli_exp_y_all.description:
Apply `exp(-i theta P / 2)`, with theta in radians.
`P` is Y on every logical qubit.

pauli_exp_z_all.name: pauli_exp_z_all
pauli_exp_z_all.description:
Apply `exp(-i theta P / 2)`, with theta in radians.
`P` is Z on every logical qubit.

pauli_exp_z_all_except_at.name: pauli_exp_z_all_except_at
pauli_exp_z_all_except_at.description:
Apply `exp(-i theta P / 2)`, with theta in radians.
`P` is Z on every logical qubit except `i`, where it is I.

pauli_exp_z_all_except_x_at.name: pauli_exp_z_all_except_x_at
pauli_exp_z_all_except_x_at.description:
Apply `exp(-i theta P / 2)`, with theta in radians.
`P` is Z on every logical qubit except `i`, where it is X.

put.description: Return a dynamic logical qubit to its originating block.

restore.name: restore
